School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
We empower students and staff to tackle global challenges through modern electrical and electronic engineering. Our excellence lies in scientific rigor, discipline depth, and real-world impact, creating a world-class environment for education and research.

28 October 2026
Metamaterials could be fitted to basic glasses to enable the wearer to see AR images, such as health and safety or assistive technology information. Credit: Professor Andrea Di Falco and Dr Yuhui Gan (University of St Andrews).
University of Sheffield researchers to drive metamaterials development
Researchers from the University of Sheffield are supporting a new national roadmap to establish the UK as a world-leader in metamaterials innovation - advanced materials that could transform critical technologies.
22 October 2026
University of Sheffield team achieves 3rd place and $500,000 in the XPRIZE Wildfire competition
Experts from the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering have been awarded a 3rd place award in the finals of the prestigious XPRIZE Wildfire Autonomous Wildfire Response competition.
